reason: The README describes a mobile interface plugin that adds LAN reverse-proxy access, iOS PWA support, touch-oriented styling, and QR-based connection setup for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI; it carries R2 risk because LAN clients may fully drive the Harness, including code-execution tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供局域网手机访问、iOS PWA 外壳、触屏适配和二维码连接页面。
summaries.en: Adds LAN mobile access, an iOS PWA shell, touch-friendly styling, and a QR-code connection page to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

capabilities: Binds a LAN-facing reverse proxy on 0.0.0.0
Forwards HTTP and WebSocket traffic to the local Harness service
Rewrites Host and Origin headers for trusted API access
Injects iOS PWA metadata, icons, and mobile touch CSS
Provides a QR-code page for mobile access
Optionally restricts clients by IP address
